# tracking: API (OpenAPI 3.1 generated by FastAPI -> contracts/openapi/tracking.json)

Common: all calls via api-gateway with internal JWT (`aud=tracking`, roles buyer|merchant, EdDSA, V design ADR-006). Headers: `X-Request-Id`/trace id, `Idempotency-Key` on mutating calls. Errors: `{ "error": {"code": "STABLE_CODE", "message": "...", "trace_id": "..."} }`. All carrier payloads include `"simulated": true`, `"carrier_label": "SIMULATED CARRIER"`. Times are ISO-8601 UTC; `*_sim` are demo-clock times. Pagination: `?limit&cursor`. Rate limits: gateway (429 + Retry-After).

## Endpoints
| method path | role | purpose |
|---|---|---|
| POST /shipments | merchant | add tracking (+ PayPal tracker signal) |
| GET /shipments/{order_id} | buyer (own order), merchant | shipment(s) + consistency block |
| GET /shipments/{order_id}/verify?claim= | internal (resolution), merchant | claim consistency check |
| POST /shipments/{id}/cancel | merchant | cancel (PayPal PATCH CANCELLED) |
| GET /demo/clock | buyer, merchant | current sim time |
| POST /demo/clock/advance | merchant + SANDBOX | jump the clock |
| POST /demo/clock/reset | merchant + SANDBOX | reset demo state |
| POST /demo/shipments/{id}/force | merchant + SANDBOX | force next status |
| POST /detector/run | merchant, internal | run one tick |
| POST /internal/tick | secret header | external tick trigger |
| POST /internal/events | internal (HMAC) | receive `order.captured` |
| GET /internal/events?after=seq | internal | outbox pull |
| GET /healthz, /readyz, /healthz/deep | none (no secrets in body) | liveness/readiness/keep-warm |

## POST /shipments
Req: `{"order_id":"ord_1","tracking_number":"TRK123","carrier_name":"Demo Carrier","outcome_profile":"ON_TIME|LATE|LOST|DELIVERED_AFTER_LATE"}` (`outcome_profile` accepted only when PS_TRACKING_SANDBOX_MODE; default ON_TIME). capture_id/mandate_id/promise date are server-derived.
201: `{"id":"shp_1","order_id":"ord_1","status":"LABEL_CREATED","promised_at_sim":"...","paypal_sync":"ADDED|FAILED|NOT_ATTEMPTED","paypal_tracker_id":"<capture_id>-TRK123","simulated":true,"carrier_label":"SIMULATED CARRIER"}`
Codes: 200 idempotent replay; 400 `VALIDATION`; 401/403 (`ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED`); 404 `ORDER_NOT_FOUND`; 409 `ORDER_NOT_CAPTURED`, `DUPLICATE_TRACKING`; 429; 503 `DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE` (checkout unreachable: fail closed, nothing created). PayPal failure is NOT an error: 201 with `paypal_sync":"FAILED"`.
Events: `shipment.created`.

## GET /shipments/{order_id}
200: `{"order_id":"ord_1","sim_now":"...","shipments":[{"id":"shp_1","status":"IN_TRANSIT","active":true,"promised_at_sim":"...","anomaly":null,"events":[{"seq":1,"to":"IN_TRANSIT","source":"SCRIPT","occurred_at_sim":"..."}]}],"consistency":{"delivered":false,"delivered_at_sim":null,"late_detected":false,"lost_detected":false},"simulated":true}`
Runs lazy catch-up first. Codes: 403 (buyer not owner), 404.

## GET /shipments/{order_id}/verify?claim=LOST
200: `{"result":"CONSISTENT|CONTRADICTED|INSUFFICIENT","reason_code":"CARRIER_SAYS_DELIVERED|NOT_YET_LATE|NO_TRACKING|...","sim_now":"..."}`. claim in LATE|LOST|NOT_DELIVERED. 400 on unknown claim.

## POST /shipments/{id}/cancel
Req `{"reason_code":"MERCHANT_CANCEL"}`. 200 `{"status":"CANCELLED","paypal_sync":"CANCELLED|FAILED"}` (V: PayPal cancel irreversible; a replacement needs a new tracking number via POST /shipments). 409 `ILLEGAL_TRANSITION`. Event: `shipment.status_changed`.

## POST /demo/clock/advance
Headers `Idempotency-Key` required. Req `{"delta_seconds":259200,"reason":"DEMO_SKIP_TO_LATE"}` (value illustrative).
200: `{"from_sim":"...","to_sim":"...","version":7,"tick":{"applied":3,"detected":1,"skipped_lease":false}}`
Codes: 404 when PS_TRACKING_SANDBOX_MODE or PS_TRACKING_DEMO_CONTROLS_ENABLED off; 401/403 non-merchant; 400 delta out of bounds; 409 `CLOCK_VERSION_CONFLICT` (retry); 429. Replay of same key returns 200 with original body. Audit: `demo.action_performed`.

## POST /demo/clock/reset
Req `{"reason":"DEMO_RESET"}`. 200 `{"offset_seconds":0}`. Same guards. Resets only `demo=true` shipments' scripts/detections.

## POST /demo/shipments/{id}/force
Req `{"to_status":"LOST","reason":"DEMO_FORCE_LOST"}`. 200 `{"id":"shp_1","status":"LOST","source":"FORCE","tick":{...}}`. 409 `ILLEGAL_TRANSITION`; 404 as above; 403 if shipment belongs to another merchant and is not demo.

## POST /detector/run and POST /internal/tick
Response 200 `{"trigger":"manual|inprocess|ping|external","skipped_lease":false,"applied":0,"detected":0,"sim_now":"..."}`. `/internal/tick` requires header `X-Tick-Secret` (compared in constant time); 401 otherwise; rate-limited. Both idempotent.

## Events (JSON Schema `contracts/events/<name>.v1.json`; envelope per overview section 7)
| event | when | consumers |
|---|---|---|
| shipment.created | POST /shipments | audit |
| shipment.status_changed | each applied transition (incl. anomaly) | audit, resolution (optional) |
| shipment.late_detected | first LATE detection (event_id = uuid5(shipment:LATE)) | resolution, audit |
| shipment.lost_detected | first LOST detection | resolution, audit |
| demo.action_performed (new, C3) | each simulator action | audit |
Consumes: `order.captured` (checkout). Payload `late_detected`: `{shipment_id, order_id, capture_id, mandate_id, kind:"LATE", promised_at_sim, detected_at_sim, carrier_status, anomaly, simulated:true}`.

## Health
`/healthz` 200 process up. `/readyz` 200 if DB reachable and clock row present, body lists dependency flags (adapter, checkout, audit reachability = informational). `/healthz/deep` checks DB, triggers a rate-limited tick, no sensitive data.
